scripts.dev: npm run load-env && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run load-env && cd react-frontEnd/ai-hr && npm run dev -- -p ${FRONTEND_PORT:-3000}
scripts.dev:custom: npm run load-env && concurrently "npm run dev:backend:custom" "npm run dev:frontend:custom"
scripts.dev:backend:custom: npm run load-env && cd dotnet-backend/ai-hr && dotnet run --urls=$ASPNETCORE_URLS
scripts.dev:frontend:custom: npm run load-env && cd react-frontEnd/ai-hr && npm run dev -- -p ${FRONTEND_PORT:-3000}
scripts.env:setup: echo 'Setting up environment files...' && npm run env:setup:backend && npm run env:setup:frontend
scripts.env:setup:backend: cp dotnet-backend/ai-hr/.env.example dotnet-backend/ai-hr/.env 2>/dev/null || echo 'Backend .env.example not found'
scripts.env:setup:frontend: cp react-frontEnd/ai-hr/.env.local.example react-frontEnd/ai-hr/.env.local 2>/dev/null || echo 'Frontend .env.local.example not found'
